log.text: Relief fund proposed agreement #1 with rule 0x93886092… — contract terms match the signed text
Relief fund signed 0x93886092… and deposited 50,000.00 DEMO
ERA5 provider posted 66 days of readings (published to 2021-08-05); the contract computed a 9-day hot spell against the signed thresholds
ERA5 provider posted 7 days of readings (published to 2021-08-12); the contract computed a 10-day hot spell against the signed thresholds
During the season the two records never both showed a qualifying spell, so nothing was released early.
Season over. Chain clock moved to 1 October (simulated clock).
Station provider fetched station data 0381122e81… + ERA5 data 4ee56f24dc… and posted the remaining 122 days of readings; the contract computed: rule NOT met, longest spell 4 days
ERA5 provider fetched ERA5 data 4ee56f24dc… and posted the remaining 49 days of readings; the contract computed: heatwave rule MET, longest spell 10 days
Settled what the data decide: 15,000.00 DEMO returned to the fund at once; only the providers' difference, 35,000.00 DEMO, goes to dispute.
30 days passed without a unanimous decision → the signed fallback applied: 35,000.00 DEMO returned to the fund (refund).
Fund tried to sign a different base period after the season → contract refused (WrongStatus).
